descriptionModule.briefSummary: This is a two-part study, intended to investigate the safety, tolerability, characteristics of PK and PD of single SC dose of SRSD216 and to identify a dose range for further studies in subjects with elevated Lp(a) level with or without ASCVD history.

identificationModule.briefTitle: A Study of SRSD216 in Patients With Elevated Lipoprotein (a)
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase I/II, Randomized, Double Blind, Placebo Controlled, Dose-Escalation and -Expansion Study to Evaluate the Safety, Tolerability, PK, and PD of Subcutaneously Administered SRSD216 in Patients With Elevated Lipoprotein(a)

primaryOutcomes.description: A summary of TEAE to evaluate the safety and tolerability of SRSD216
